comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
8-item Memorial Album related to trade goods that are commonly used alchemy ingredients. It consists of the following items which you may buy/plunder/collect through various means:

Salt
Mandrake
Silver
Cinnabar
Western Books
Sulphur
Paper
Mercury

Reward is the Basic Alchemy-Secrets from Paracelsus in Venice. Cheers.
